dct_description_sm: This dataset is made available under the Statistics Canada Open Licence Agreement: https://www.statcan.gc.ca/eng/reference/licence. The dataset is in Beyond 20/20 (.ivt) format. The Beyond 20/20 browser is required in order to open it. This software can be freely downloaded from the Statistics Canada website: https://www.statcan.gc.ca/eng/public/beyond20-20 (Windows only).

This dataset is a custom tabulation of the 2011 National Household Survey containing shelter cost statistics (rent, electricity, fuel, water and other municipal services, mortgage payments, property taxes and condominium fees) for private households in non-band non-farm non-reserve occupied private dwellings in the City of Toronto.
dct_title_s: 2011 National Household Survey, Shelter Costs at the Dissemination Area (DA) Level in the City of Toronto Census Subdivision (CSD)
